about_short_description.short_description: Axle Labs is an insurance data open platform that helps to link policies and verify and monitor ongoing insurance coverage.

product.name: Axle Verification
product.description: A service that retrieves insurance policy and coverage data directly from carriers for real-time verification.

product.name: Axle Monitoring
product.description: A policy-monitoring service that detects insurance changes and sends notifications when coverage renews, cancels, lapses, or is modified.

product.name: Axle Document AI
product.description: An insurance document processing service that extracts structured policy information from uploaded cards, binders, declarations pages, and other documents.

product.name: Axle Validation
product.description: A rules-based insurance evaluation service that determines whether a policy satisfies an organization’s coverage and compliance requirements.

product.name: Axle Ignition
product.description: A hosted and embeddable interface for collecting user consent and connecting insurance accounts or uploading proof of insurance.

product.name: Axle API
product.description: An API that enables applications to retrieve standardized insurance policy information and receive policy-related events.
